name: stateseal
description: Visible, transactional verified delivery for coding-agent changes

interface.longDescription: StateSeal visibly routes code-changing tasks through an isolated proposal, independent verification, a state-bound receipt, and explicit final Apply. Read-only work stays on the Agent's normal path, and StateSeal infrastructure failures degrade visibly without blocking ordinary development.
